🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION, Growth/Momentum style. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5). Confirmations: strong sector breadth alongside major 1W/1M divergences across large caps (AAPL, QCOM, INTC, META, TSLA) — watch for trend breaks.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: NEM (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%) ABOVE TREND and FCX (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +15.30%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -1.54% | 1M: +11.33%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%) CORRECTION, EOG (1W: -9.38% | 1M: +1.65%) CORRECTION. Utilities lag: VST (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND, SRE (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -11.35%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: VLO (1W: -4.66% | 1M: +6.48%) CORRECTION, F (1W: -4.77% | 1M: +2.72%) CORRECTION, MAR (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND, SRE (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -11.35%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Energy/Utilities and select Consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.69% | 1M: -9.68%) RECOVERY. Note major divergence risk: several large names show 1W bounces vs negative 1M — tactical, not full trend confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology mixed but leading on 1W strength; NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY. Sector performance 1W +9.24% (24 stocks) — momentum present but internal reversals warrant caution.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials steady and constructive: JPM (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -0.99% | 1M: +4.11%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +7.60%) CORRECTION. Financials showing broad participation on 1W; sector performance 1W +1.48% (20 stocks).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed with pockets of defensive strength: PFE (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +0.05%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.77% | 1M: -5.70%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: -2.57%) RECOVERY. Sector performance 1W +1.77% (17 stocks) — defensive but uneven.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor high-conviction Technology and select Materials/Industrials exposure while reducing exposure to names with 1W/1M divergence (AAPL, QCOM, INTC, META) until follow-through; Financials remain a constructive sleeve. Style: Growth/Momentum favored but CAUTION on narrow leadership and multiple reversals.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CVX (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%) CORRECTION, EOG (1W: -9.38% | 1M: +1.65%) CORRECTION, CVS (1W: -8.36% | 1M: -6.34%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +9.24%) and Materials (1W: +6.28%) — monitor leadership breadth within Tech. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -3.43%) and Utilities (1W: -1.76%) where recent weakness and negative headlines increase tail risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND — hold this week’s breakout for continuation. AAPL (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY — failure to push 1M back positive would invalidate the short-term bounce. JPM (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND — sustained moves above recent 1M gains would confirm Financials participation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MPC (+80): MPC (1W: -5.77% | 1M: +5.26%) CORRECTION — bullish headlines on refining profitability but price shows short-term profit-taking (divergence). PFE (+75): PFE (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming accumulation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (-60): ORCL (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines on credit risk but price is rallying (divergence). BA (-50): BA (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +5.07%) ABOVE TREND — FAA inspection headlines contrast with strong price action (watch for follow-through).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, Growth/Momentum style. MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow tech leadership and widespread 1W/1M divergences (AAPL, QCOM, INTC, META) amid mixed sentiment (ORCL/BA headline divergence) — monitor for confirmed trend continuation.
